confidence_notes: Restaurant, cappuccino and draft beer anchors use current Tangier aggregated typical prices converted with an approximate MAD/USD rate. Alcohol prices are less certain: the cocktail estimate uses a current Tangier cost index, while the wine estimate uses a Morocco bar-price range and is set at about 1.5 times the local draft-beer estimate. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and vary with season and property standards.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city was needed for food and drink because current Tangier price-index data was available; accommodation reflects general knowledge of Tangier's tourism market.
